Class ClientCommandHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.network.tcp.ClientCommandHandler
public class ClientCommandHandler extends Object
Converts one raw TCP line received from a client into a typed client command.

This class is part of the server-side TCP boundary, but it does not manage the socket. VirtualViewTCP reads raw text lines from the connection and passes each line here. This handler only understands the JSON protocol: it validates the common message envelope, deserializes the payload required by the declared ClientMessageType, and gives the resulting command back to the virtual view as a ClientMessage.

The handler deliberately does not execute lobby or game logic. After parsing, normal commands are forwarded to VirtualViewTCP.handleClientMessage(ClientMessage). The only command handled directly here is ClientMessageType.PONG, because it belongs to the connection keep-alive protocol and must update the connection state instead of reaching the application controllers.

In the TCP protocol every client message must contain both type and payload. This also applies to PONG: the payload may be empty, but the envelope is still expected to contain it so that all client messages keep the same shape.

  • Method Details

    • handle

      public void handle(String rawMessage)
      Parses and dispatches one raw client message.

      The input must be a JSON object with a type field matching a ClientMessageType value and a non-null payload field. The declared type selects the concrete ClientPayload class used for deserialization.

      For regular commands, the method builds a ClientMessage and passes it to the associated VirtualViewTCP. For PONG, it updates the keep-alive state directly through VirtualViewTCP.pong(PongPayload).

      Parameters:
      rawMessage - JSON line received from the TCP socket
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the JSON envelope, message type, or payload is malformed
      UnsupportedOperationException - if the message type is valid but not supported by this TCP deserializer
